args.command: echo '=== display stack ==='; command -v Xorg || true; command -v startx || true; command -v weston || true; command -v cage || true; command -v gnome-shell || true; command -v openbox || true; command -v dbus-run-session || true; echo '=== display managers ==='; systemctl status display-manager --no-pager -n 5 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== seats/sessions ==='; loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== chatgpt binary/desktop ==='; command -v chatgpt || true; dpkg -L chatgpt 2>/dev/null | grep -E '/(bin|applications)/' | head -40 || true; echo '=== gpu/display devices ==='; ls -l /dev/dri 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l /dev/tty0 /dev/tty3 2>/dev/null || true
